guard: cotal_spawn carries model and manager-instance pins, refuses malformed instances before invoke, and rejects explicit pins outside credential authority
why: The live defect was silence: cotal_spawn accepted model, the seat came up on the harness default,
and neither the spawn result nor orientation named the pin, so a review panel reported as
cross-vendor was same-family. Forwarding the argument is not the proof; recording it is.
A1 drops the inspect attestation so a successful spawn with a requested model never checks the
recorded pin. A2 keeps inspect but reports success even when inspect recorded a different model.
A3 hides the recorded model from the tool result so a caller can still believe a pin it cannot see.
A4 drops the instance option at the manager boundary. A5 removes lifecycle-token validation.
A6 disables the user-auth disagreement guard so an explicit pin can be silently overridden.

mutations.name: A1 skip inspect after a requested model, so a dropped pin looks like success
mutations.expectRed: a requested model the manager did not record is refused

mutations.name: A2 treat any recorded model as the requested pin
mutations.expectRed: a requested model that inspect records as a different pin is refused

mutations.name: A3 hide the recorded model from the published spawn result
mutations.expectRed: cotal_spawn tool names the recorded model on success

mutations.name: A4 drop the manager instance pin at the invokeService boundary
mutations.find: const reply = await this.managerInvoke("spawn", args, { deadlineMs: SPAWN_TIMEOUT_MS, follow: true, ...(instance !== undefined ? { instanceId: instance } : {}) });
mutations.replace: const reply = await this.managerInvoke("spawn", args, { deadlineMs: SPAWN_TIMEOUT_MS, follow: true });
mutations.expectRed: instance pin reaches invokeService and requests a pinned resolve

mutations.name: A5 skip manager instance lifecycle-token validation
mutations.expectRed: a malformed instance is refused before invoke

mutations.name: A6 disable explicit instance disagreement refusal in user mode
mutations.find: if (this.config.userAuth && instance !== undefined && this.config.managerInstanceId !== undefined && instance !== this.config.managerInstanceId)
mutations.replace: if (false && this.config.userAuth && instance !== undefined && this.config.managerInstanceId !== undefined && instance !== this.config.managerInstanceId)
mutations.expectRed: user mode: an explicit instance that differs from credential authority is refused before invoke
